description: This file defines classes and functions for logging within the TestLink project. It includes implementations for logging to database tables, files, and email, as well as managing log transactions, levels, and error handling. It also sets up global loggers and handles shutdown procedures.

classes.name: tlLogger
classes.description: Main logging class managing different loggers, log levels, and transactions for the TestLink application.

classes.name: tlTransaction
classes.description: Represents a logging transaction, including start/end times and related events.

classes.name: tlEvent
classes.description: Represents individual log events with details like level, description, source, and timestamp.

classes.name: tlEventManager
classes.description: Manages retrieval and deletion of log events from the database.

classes.name: tlDBLogger
classes.description: Logs events directly into the database tables.

classes.name: tlFileLogger
classes.description: Logs events to a log file, managing formatting and file writing.

classes.name: tlMailLogger
classes.description: Sends log events via email based on configured levels.

methods.name: watchPHPErrors
methods.description: Custom error handler to capture PHP errors, warnings, and notices for logging.

methods.name: shutdownLogger
methods.description: Shutdown function ensuring the current transaction is properly closed at script termination.
